Result is a tuple of strings? It shows "(('COc1cccc(N)c1', 'Nc1c(C(=O)O)nnn1Cc1ccc(CN2CC(F)C2)cc1'),)". So two precursors: "COc1cccc(N)c1" (p-anisidine? Actually anisidine missing OCH3? It has COc1cccc(N)c1 which is anisidine (methoxy phenyl amine). Good. Second: "Nc1c(C(=O)O)nnn1Cc1ccc(CN2CC(F)C2)cc1" which is triazine with carboxylic acid and side chain.

Now we need to further disconnect the second precursor to get commercially available leaves.

We need to break the bond between triazine and side chain maybe via SN2. Let's search for templates that break C-N bond (alkyl amine). Use functional_groups_broken maybe "amine". Or bonds_broken "C-N". Let's search.
